This doc contains all of the data pre-processing, along with notes on how it all happened.
NOTE: Extract the .zip file "LLCP2023XPT" before running this code. The dataset file is so large that it will not upload to GitHub without being compacted first.

```{r}
# Remove all previous items from environment
remove(list=ls())

# Packages
library(dplyr) # Data cleaning
library(haven) # Read .XPT file
library(MatchIt) # Non-parametric Pre-processing

# Read in the entire dataset
full_dataset <- read_xpt("Data/LLCP2023XPT/LLCP2023.xpt")
```

The next few code chunks detail the process of finding important variables

```{r}
first50 <- full_dataset %>%
  select(1:50)

## SEQNO - Annual sequence number
## SEXVAR - Sex of respondent
## EXERANY2 - Exercise in the last 30 days
## STRENGTH - How many times do you do physical activity...
```

```{r}
last50 <- full_dataset %>%
  select(301:350)

## HTIN4 - Computed height in inches
## _LTASTH1 - lifetime asthma (calculated variable)
## _CASTHM1 - current asthma (calculated variable)
## _SEX - sex (calculated variable)
## _AGE_G - Imputed age in six groups
## _BMI5 - Computed BMI
## _BMI5CAT - Computer BMI categories
## _RFBMI5 - BMI indicator (overweight or obese = ?)
## _SMOKER3 - Computed smoking status
## _RFSMOK3 - Current smoker (calculated variable)
## _CURECI2 - Current e-cigarette use (calculated variable)
```

```{r}
# Order by variable group: ID & Cancer, Demographics, BMI & general health, Asthma, Smoking, E-cigs and other forms of tobacco, miscellaneous
select_data <- full_dataset %>%
  select(SEQNO, CNCRDIFF, CNCRTYP2, SEXVAR, `_AGE_G`, HTIN4, WEIGHT2, `_BMI5`, `_BMI5CAT`, `_RFBMI5`, PHYSHLTH, EXERANY2, STRENGTH, ASTHMA3, `_LTASTH1`, `_CASTHM1`, `_SMOKER3`, `_RFSMOK3`, LCSFIRST, LCSNUMCG, SMOKE100, ECIGNOW2, `_CURECI2`, MENTCIGS, MENTECIG, USENOW3, HEATTBCO, CHCCOPD3, COVIDPO1)
```

```{r}
# 3. Clean and recode features
clean_df <- select_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Target: 1 if Lung Cancer (code 14), 0 otherwise
    LUNG_CANCER = if_else(CNCRTYP2 == 14, 1, 0, missing = 0),
    
    # COPD: 1 = Yes, 0 = No (filter out 7=Don't know, 9=Refused)
    COPD = case_when(CHCCOPD3 == 1 ~ 1, CHCCOPD3 == 2 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    
    # Asthma: 1 = Yes, 0 = No
    ASTHMA = case_when(ASTHMA3 == 1 ~ 1, ASTHMA3 == 2 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    
    # Smoking: 1 = Current/Former, 0 = Never
    SMOKER = case_when(`_SMOKER3` %in% c(1, 2, 3) ~ 1, `_SMOKER3` == 4 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    
    # Days with poor physical symptoms (88 means zero days in BRFSS)
    POOR_PHYS_DAYS = case_when(PHYSHLTH == 88 ~ 0, PHYSHLTH <= 30 ~ PHYSHLTH, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    
    # BMI (stored with 2 implied decimal places)
    BMI = `_BMI5` / 100,
    
    # Assign each age group its literal meaning
    AGE_GROUP = ifelse(`_AGE_G` == 1, "18-24",
                       ifelse(`_AGE_G` == 2, "25-34",
                              ifelse(`_AGE_G` == 3, "35-44",
                                     ifelse(`_AGE_G` == 4, "45-54",
                                            ifelse(`_AGE_G` == 5, "55-64", "65+"))))),
    
    # Male or Female as reported by the respondent
    GENDER = ifelse(SEXVAR == 1, "Male", "Female"),
    
    # If respondent exercised in the past month, 1
    EXERCISE = ifelse(EXERANY2==1, 1, 0),
    
    # If respondent has smoked 100 cigarettes lifetime, 1
    SMOKE100 = case_when(SMOKE100 %in% c(1,7) ~ 1, !(SMOKE100 %in% c(1,7)) ~ 0),
    
    # If respondent currently smokes e-cigarettes, 1
    ECIGS = ifelse(`_CURECI2` == 2, 1, 0),
    
    # If respondent currently uses smokeless tobacco, 1
    SMOKELESS_TOBACCO = ifelse(USENOW3 %in% c(1,2), 1, 0),
    
    # If respondent has ever been diagnosed with COVID-19, 1
    COVID19 = ifelse(COVIDPO1 == 1, 1, 0)
    
  ) %>%
  
  rename("HEIGHT"=HTIN4,
         "WEIGHT"=WEIGHT2) %>%
  
  select(SEQNO, LUNG_CANCER, COPD, ASTHMA, SMOKER, POOR_PHYS_DAYS, HEIGHT, WEIGHT, BMI, AGE_GROUP, GENDER, EXERCISE, SMOKE100, ECIGS, SMOKELESS_TOBACCO, COVID19)
```

```{r}
# Obtain non-cancer observations through MatchIt
# Addresses class difference before cross validation

library(MatchIt)
set.seed(123)
matched_model <- matchit(
  LUNG_CANCER ~ AGE_GROUP + GENDER,
  data = clean_df,
  method = "nearest",
  ratio = 3
)

# Extract the matched dataset (~1,500 rows)
balanced_data <- match.data(matched_model)
```


```{r}
# 4. Filter out NAs in custom columns
balanced_data <- balanced_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(COPD), !is.na(ASTHMA), !is.na(SMOKER), !is.na(POOR_PHYS_DAYS), !is.na(HEIGHT), !is.na(WEIGHT), !is.na(BMI), !is.na(COVID19)) %>%
  select(SEQNO:COVID19)

# 5. Check total lung cancer cases
table(balanced_data$LUNG_CANCER)
```

```{r}
write.csv(balanced_data, "final_dataset.csv")
```
